title: Dry Tortugas National Park - Traveling Robert
description:
This is the short version of a longer trip we made to Key West and the Dry Tortugas National Park. Tomorrow I will upload the longer version.
We travel aboard a 2015 Winnebago Micro Minnie 1706FB travel trailer. You are more than welcome to tag along in our travels by subscribing to this channel.

If you find value in what I do you can become a producer by going to http://patreon.com/travelingrobert
